Today Bank of America Reiterates a “Buy” Rating on Paycom Software (NYSE:PAYC) and a $134 Target Price
August 2, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade Paycom Software (NYSE:PAYC) Rating Reaffirmed
Bank of America now has a $134 target on the $7.44B market cap company or 6.40 % upside potential. In analysts note sent to investors and clients on Wednesday, 1 August, Paycom Software (NYSE:PAYC) shares have had their “Buy” Rating reaffirmed by analysts at Bank of America. Paycom Software, Inc. (NYSE:PAYC) Ratings Coverage
Among 9 analysts covering Paycom ( NYSE:PAYC ), 5 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 4 Hold. Therefore 56% are positive. Paycom has $13000 highest and $85 lowest target. $112’s average target is -11.07% below currents $125.94 stock price. Paycom had 15 analyst reports since February 6, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. Barclays Capital maintained it with “Overweight” rating and $97 target in Wednesday, February 7 report. First Analysis downgraded the shares of PAYC in report on Wednesday, May 2 to “Hold” rating. As per Friday, March 23, the company rating was downgraded by Stifel Nicolaus. The firm has “Overweight” rating given on Tuesday, February 13 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. The firm earned “Equal-Weight” rating on Wednesday, May 2 by Barclays Capital. Jefferies maintained the shares of PAYC in report on Thursday, April 19 with “Buy” rating. On Wednesday, May 2 the stock rating was maintained by Credit Suisse with “Neutral”. The company was maintained on Wednesday, February 7 by Stifel Nicolaus. As per Tuesday, February 6, the company rating was maintained by Jefferies. Robert W. Baird maintained Paycom Software, Inc. (NYSE:PAYC) on Tuesday, February 6 with “Buy” rating.
The stock increased 18.53% or $19.69 $125.94. About 4.37M shares traded or 455.26% up from the average. Paycom Software, Inc. (NYSE:PAYC) has risen 57.82% uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.25% the S&P500.
Paycom Software, Inc. provides cloud human capital management software solution that is delivered as software-as-a-service for small to mid-sized companies in the United States. $7.44 billion. It provides functionality and data analytics that businesses need to manage the employment life cycle from recruitment to retirement. It currently has negative earnings. The companyÂ’s HCM solution offers a suite of applications in the areas of talent acquisition, including applicant tracking, candidate tracker, background checks, on-boarding, E-Verify, and tax credit service applications; and time and labor management, such as time and attendance, scheduling/schedule exchange, time-off requests, labor allocation, labor management reports/push reporting, and geofencing/geotracking applications.
